physics-killer-08.topic: Newton's laws of motion and special relativity
physics-killer-08.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-08.material: Muon wey form for upper atmosphere of Earth dey fly vertically down toward di ground with speed $0.8c$. Relative to Earth (ground), di height of di creation point na $800\,\mathrm{m}$, and di average lifetime wey dem measure for di rest frame of di muon na $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Take $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Which one correctly match, in order, di distance from di creation point to di ground as dem see am for di rest frame of di muon, and di time wey di muon take to pass dat distance?
physics-killer-08.thinking.0: Newton's laws of motion and special relativity
physics-killer-08.s.s1.prompt: Muon wey form for upper atmosphere of Earth dey fly vertically down toward di ground with speed $0.8c$. Relative to Earth (ground), di height of di creation point na $800\,\mathrm{m}$, and di average lifetime wey dem measure for di rest frame of di muon na $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Take $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Which one correctly match, in order, di distance from di creation point to di ground as dem see am for di rest frame of di muon, and di time wey di muon take to pass dat distance?
physics-killer-08.s.s1.explain: $\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-0.8^2}=5/3$. Length contraction: $L=L_0/\gamma=800\cdot\dfrac35=480\,\mathrm{m}$. Time $t=\dfrac{L}{v}=\dfrac{480}{0.8\cdot3\times10^8}=2.0\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{s}=2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Dis one equal di proper lifetime of di muon. Observer for Earth go explain di same phenomenon with time dilation: $\Delta t=\dfrac{800}{0.8c}=3.3\,\mu\mathrm{s}=\gamma\cdot2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. If you multiply e be $1333\,\mathrm{m}$ (wrong answer ①), if you multiply $\gamma$ instead of $v/c$ e be $640\,\mathrm{m}$ (wrong answer ②), and if you ignore di contraction na wrong answer ④.
physics-killer-08.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-08.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-08.s.s1.hint.0: For di muon frame, di distance to di ground na $L=\dfrac{L_0}{\gamma}$ by length contraction ($L_0$ na di proper length relative to Earth), $\gamma=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1-(v/c)^2}}$.
